subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 full-SHA action updates land as one batch after a fresh rebase and targeted validation, or should secret-bearing Codex, token, and registry actions be reviewed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but CI cannot fully settle the security and availability impact of newer third-party code in scheduled and release-only workflows.

options.title: Validate and land together
options.body: Rebase the grouped PR, verify all upstream SHAs and release notes, and run representative sensitive workflow paths before merging the coherent batch.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, registry, and publishing action updates from lower-risk toolchain and scanner bumps for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Leave the PR open until dependency-gate failures and upstream action review can be completed without weakening workflow coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate and land together
recommendation.body: Rebase the grouped PR, verify all upstream SHAs and release notes, and run representative sensitive workflow paths before merging the coherent batch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct involvement in release workflow operation, Docker release safeguards, and validation of the most sensitive changed path.
